title: THE BASEMENT IS A STUDIO?! 🎬
topic: The family discovers they are the stars of a secret reality show.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: STOP! DON'T TOUCH THAT HANDLE OR THE ENTIRE HOUSE IS GOING TO LOCK DOWN AND TRAP US DOWN HERE FOREVER!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Nix [beat] look at those monitors [beat] why is your entire life playing out on twenty different screens at the same time?

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: This isn't just a basement [beat] it’s a high-tech production studio [beat] and look [beat] my house is on one of these screens too!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait [beat] that's Dad in the kitchen [beat] but he's wearing the same shirt from three years ago [beat] this is all recorded footage!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: If this is all old recordings [beat] then why is the red 'LIVE' light blinking on the camera pointed directly at us right now?

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I told you kids to stay in the attic [beat] because some secrets are better left buried under the foundation of this house!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Dad [beat] what are you doing down here with all this surveillance gear and why is Uncle Jamal's name on all these server bills?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Because dear nephew [beat] privacy is a luxury that only the poor believe they actually possess in this digital world!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: Oh [beat] don't look so shocked Nix [beat] the whole neighborhood has been paying for the premium subscription to your family drama!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You've been selling our lives as a reality show [beat] and we never even got a single cent of the profit for any of this?

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: The profit went into paying for this mansion [beat] but now that you've found the server room [beat] we have to start the final protocol!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait [beat] what does 'Final Protocol' mean [beat] and why are the basement walls starting to slide inward like a trash compactor?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The basement reveal was a trap [beat] and Nix is about to find out exactly how this series is scheduled to end!
